Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!


Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

title: Terapeuta ocupacional pediátrico

title: AI-First Frontend Engineer (Next.js & React) - Remote
description:
About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.


Location: Remote / Hybrid - we accept candidates located across LATAM, South America, Europe

Seniority: Mid-Level / Senior (Individual Contributor)


Role Overview

LumiMeds is a high-growth telehealth platform building the next generation of virtual telehealth infrastructure. We are looking for an AI-First Frontend Engineer who builds beautiful, performant, and clinically reliable interfaces —and uses AI to do it at a pace that consistently surprises people.


You are not a designer who codes, nor a utility developer who ships components on request. You are an engineer who can translate a Figma frame into a pixel-perfect, highly performant Next.js experience, architect the state model behind it, and use AI tooling to compress a week of work into a day. You know how to direct Claude agent teams to handle parallelizable work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility — so you can stay focused on the decisions that require human judgment. You will balance 90% hands-on codingwith 10% mentorship, and you are expected to set the bar for frontend quality and velocity on the team.


Core Technical Domains

You will own the user-facing layer across our consumer and clinical platforms:

  • Performant Marketing & E-commerce: Engineering lightning-fast, SEO-optimized storefronts and landing pages. You treat Core Web Vitals as a first-class deliverable.
  • Clinical Web Application (EMR & Provider Portal): Building the “Clinical OS” — complex, state-heavy interfaces where data integrity and reliability are non-negotiable.
  • AI-Powered UI Features: Implementing streaming LLM responses, real-time clinical summaries, and conversational interfaces embedded into patient and provider flows.
  • Virtual Care Interfaces: Implementing WebRTC video components, real-time secure messaging, and low-latency async consultation flows.
  • Design System & Motion: Maintaining a component library using Framer Motion to produce purposeful animations that make the platform feel premium and intuitive.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI-Augmented Frontend Development: Use Cursor, Copilot, and LLMs as first-class tools to generate components, write tests, and iterate on UI logic at high velocity. Prompt quality is part of the craft.
  • Claude Agent Team Orchestration: Coordinate Claude agent teams via the Claude Agent SDK to execute parallelizable frontend work — generating component variants, writing test suites, auditing accessibility, and producing design-to-code translations at scale. You know how to structure agent prompts, verify outputs, and integrate agent-generated code into the production codebase reliably.
  • Aesthetic Engineering: Translate high-fidelity Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive experiences that hold visual integrity across all device sizes and breakpoints.
  • Performance Ownership: Own Core Web Vitals — optimize LCP, INP, and bundle size. Understand hydration, streaming SSR, and caching strategies at a deep level.
  • AI UI Integration: Build and maintain frontend interfaces that consume LLM outputs — streaming text, structured responses, tool-call results — in ways that feel fluid and reliable to end users.
  • State Architecture: Design resilient client-side state capable of handling real-time clinical data, optimistic updates, and complex form flows across the patient journey.
  • Compliance & Security: Ensure all interfaces meet HIPAA/SOC2 standards, with a focus on secure data handling, audit trails, and PII protection.


Required Hard Skills & Tech Stack

  • Next.js Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of the App Router, Server Components (RSC), and sophisticated caching/streaming strategies.
  • The “Beautiful Web” Stack: Expert proficiency in Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion for fluid, high-end interfaces.
  • Performance Optimization: Proven track record optimizing bundle sizes, hydration cycles, and Lighthouse scores.
  • State Management: Expertise in TanStack Query (server state) and Zustand (client state).
  • LLM UI Patterns: Experience building streaming response UIs, chat interfaces, or AI-assisted input flows using OpenAI or Anthropic APIs.
  • Claude Agent Teams: Hands-on experience building and directing Claude agent teams using the Claude Agent SDK — from bulk component generation to automated visual regression and test coverage. You can design an agent pipeline, define subagent roles, and validate the output before it lands in production.
  • AI Dev Tooling: Daily active use of Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent. Strong opinions on how to use AI for component generation, refactoring, and test writing.
  • Browser Fundamentals: Deep understanding of the DOM, rendering pipeline, and HIPAA-compliant data handling in the browser.


Candidate Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience.
  • AI-Native Workflow: You can demonstrate concretely how AI has accelerated your frontend output. Examples or portfolio required.
  • The Dual-Threat Portfolio: Proven experience building both visually polished, high-traffic marketing sites and complex, data-driven SaaS applications.
  • Uncompromising Eye for Detail: You notice when spacing is off by 2px and care enough to fix it. Typography, micro-interactions, and motion are part of your craft.
  • High Agency: Ability to self-direct, operate in ambiguity, and make high-leverage frontend decisions without constant supervision.
  • Communication: Professional proficiency in English for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.


Why Join LumiMeds?

  • AI as Infrastructure: We don’t bolt AI on — it’s embedded in how we build. You’ll be encouraged and expected to use every tool available to ship faster and better.
  • Design-Forward Culture: We believe healthcare should be beautiful. You’ll have the technical freedom to build a premium brand experience without compromise.
  • Direct Impact: Fast, intuitive, and beautiful interfaces directly affect patient outcomes and provider efficiency.

title: Senior Sales Manager -New energy & EV charging
description:
Job Summary



We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Overseas Sales Manager to spearhead the market expansion and sales of our comprehensive portfolio, including energy metering products (electricity, water, gas meters) and new energy storage solutions (commercial & industrial energy storage, smart micro-grids, EV charging piles). Your Role and Responsibilities


Business Development & Revenue Generation:


  • Take full ownership of achieving and exceeding assigned annual sales targets for the designated territory.


  • Aggressively identify, generate, and pursue new sales leads and business opportunities within the energy sector.


Customer & Channel Management:


  • Develop and maintain long-term, strategic relationships with a diverse client base, including utility companies, EPC contractors, distributors, and end-users.


  • Manage key accounts to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction, account growth, and contract renewal.

  • Conduct in-depth customer needs analysis and develop tailored solutions and compelling proposals to win business.


  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead qualification and proposal development to contract negotiation and project initiation.

  • Participate in international industry tradeshows and conduct market research to gather intelligence on competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes.


  • Provide insightful market analysis reports to inform product development and strategic planning.


Cross-functional Collaboration:


  • Serve as the key liaison between customers and internal teams (technical, project management, logistics, after-sales) to ensure seamless order execution, on-time delivery, and superior customer experience.


  • Oversee post-sales support coordination to resolve issues promptly and maintain customer satisfaction.




Qualifications



Education & Background:


  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Automation, International Business, or a related field. An advanced degree is a plus.


Experience:


  • Minimum of 5 years of proven sales experience in international markets, preferably within the energy, metering, or power solution industries.


  • Strong sales track record of meeting or exceeding quotas and managing complex B2B sales cycles. Experience with Latin American markets is highly desirable.




Required Skills



Sales Expertise:


  • Demonstrated ability in key account management, channel development, and complex project negotiation.


Communication:


  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and proposal-writing skills. Fluency in Portuguese is mandatory.


Personal Attributes:


  • Highly self-motivated, results-oriented, and customer-focused. Possess strong business acumen, market sensitivity, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-cultural environment.



Preferred Skills


  • Willingness and ability to accept extended and frequent business trips or assignments.

description:

  • Implementar e fortalecer modelos de governança e acompanhamento de portfólio de projetos, com definição de KPIs, rituais executivos e reportes quando a eventuais riscos a serem mitigados;

  • Habilidades voltadas para planejamento estratégico, OKRs, metodologias de projetos, PMO, análise de impacto e viabilidade;
  • Capacidade de liderar iniciativas transversais;
  • Inglês será considerado um diferencial.


A Seguradora para um mundo em mudança


Somos líder mundial em alianças do setor de bancasseguros e seguros de proteção de crédito, com presença em 30 países e posições fortes em três regiões: Europa, Ásia e América Latina. Com mais de 9.000 mil funcionários no mundo todo.


Oferecemos soluções inovadoras por meio de parcerias estratégicas em setores como Bancos, Auto, Varejo e Digital, somos referência em seguros massificados no país. Com mais de 23 milhões de certificados ativos e mais de 1,2 milhão de novas apólices mensais, alcançamos um faturamento de R$ 3,8 bilhões em 2024.


Nossa distribuição de produtos é realizada por meio dos canais de distribuição dos nossos parceiros, físicos e online. Estamos sempre preparados para atender às necessidades de um mundo em constante transformação.

Temos a missão de potencializar nossas parcerias porque, por meio delas, protegemos brasileiros. Faremos isso com uma Proposta de Valor sólida, escalável e sustentável, assegurada por times protagonistas e engajados, sob uma cultura de alta performance.


Venha trabalhar com a gente e vamos, juntos, tornar os seguros mais acessíveis à população brasileira!

  • Identificar riscos, inconsistências e oportunidades de melhoria em processos, controles e critérios de análise;

  • Experiência prévia consistente em análise de crédito, risco, cobrança ou áreas relacionadas;

  • Comunicação clara (oral e escrita), com capacidade de sustentar tecnicamente suas análises e recomendações;
  • Postura ética, senso de responsabilidade e compromisso com a veracidade das informações;
  • Capacidade de atuar com prazos, priorização e tomada de decisão em ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Experiência com esteiras e fluxos de crédito (triagem, validação, análise, parecer e aprovação);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e visitas a clientes.


SERÁ CONSIDERADO UM DIFERENCIAL:

  • Familiaridade com políticas de crédito e monitoramento;
  • Experiência com ferramentas e sistemas de análise e controle;
  • Vivência em ambientes estruturados, com governança e acompanhamento de indicadores.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
TITLE:

Senior Mobile Engineer


LOCATION/GEOGRAPHY:

Brasília, Brazil


REPortS TO:

R&D Manager


Role summary:

As a Senior Mobile Engineer at Vingcard, you will be instrumental in maintaining and developing new features for our native iOS and Android applications. With your extensive experience in mobile development, particularly in Swift and Kotlin, you will ensure the continuous enhancement of our mobile platforms. This role will involve leading the implementation of automated testing and CI/CD pipelines to improve app quality and reliability. You will also contribute to the integration of IoT devices and may explore hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Develop and maintain native iOS and Android applications.
  • Implement new features and functionalities on the Athos mobile apps.
  • Design and execute automated tests to ensure the reliability and performance of mobile applications.
  • Establish and optimize CI/CD pipelines for mobile apps to streamline development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including UX/UI designers, product managers, and backend engineers, to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.
  • Lead initiatives to integrate IoT devices with mobile applications, enhancing product capabilities.
  • Explore and possibly implement hybrid mobile development using Flutter or React Native as needed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in mobile apps, ensuring minimal downtime and high user satisfaction.


Key Relationships:

  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Designers to create intuitive, user-friendly mobile interfaces.
  • Engage with other Engineers to solve technical challenges and share best practices.
  • Interface with Quality Assurance teams to ensure thorough testing and validation of mobile applications.


Responsibilities and Authorities:

List of responsibilities and authorities:

  • Authority to make technical decisions regarding the design and architecture of mobile applications.
  • Access to development tools, version control systems, and other resources necessary for mobile app development.
  • Responsibility for the timely and high-quality delivery of mobile features and improvements.
  • Authority to mentor junior developers and guide them in best practices for mobile development.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project updates, technical decisions, and career development matters.


Internal and External Contacts/Customers:

  • Regular collaboration with internal teams, including Product Management, Design, and Software Engineering.
  • Occasional engagement with external stakeholders, such as technology partners.


Key Competencies, Relevant Knowledge, Skills and Competencies:

  • Expertise in native iOS and Android development, with deep knowledge of Swift (for iOS) and Kotlin (for Android).
  • Experience in integrating IoT devices with mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines for mobile development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mobile app issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Adaptability and a continuous improvement mindset, with an eagerness to learn new technologies like Flutter or React Native.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in mobile app development, with a focus on native iOS and Android platforms.
  • Extensive experience with Kotlin and Swift, with a preference for Android development expertise.
  • Experience with IoT devices and hybrid mobile frameworks (Flutter/React Native) is a plus.


Education:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field.


Languages:

Proficiency in English and Brazilian Portuguese, both written and verbal.


Computer Skills:

  • Proficiency in development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Expertise in Swift and Kotlin, with familiarity in hybrid frameworks like Flutter or React Native.


Other Experience:

  • Senior Mobile Engineer or equivalent position in a software development environment.
  • Experience in mentoring and guiding junior developers.
  • Minimum 7 years experience.


Personal Qualities:

  • Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead mobile projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on quality and best practices in mobile development.
  • Flexible and adaptable, with a passion for learning and implementing new technologies.


Expected outcome and deliverables:

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Mobile Engineer will significantly enhance the Athos mobile applications by implementing robust features, automated testing, and efficient CI/CD pipelines. The role will contribute to the integration of IoT devices, potentially explore hybrid mobile development, and drive the overall quality and performance of the apps. These efforts will solidify Athos's position as a leader in innovative mobile solutions, with noticeable improvements in app reliability, user satisfaction, and market competitiveness.


Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.


We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!


Contract Details

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Engenheiro de projetos
description:
Descrição sumária:

O Engenheiro Sênior em Engenharia de Estimativa & Viabilidade é responsável por liderar e aprovar atividades técnicas relacionadas a estimativas de custos e análise de projetos. Este profissional assegura a qualidade das entregas e a satisfação do cliente, aplicando sua vasta experiência para desenvolver soluções que atendam às exigências dos projetos.

Suas responsabilidades incluem a supervisão da elaboração de estimativas complexas, a realização de análises detalhadas de viabilidade e a validação de relatórios técnicos. O Engenheiro Sênior também atua como um ponto de referência para a equipe, promovendo a adoção de melhores práticas e assegurando a conformidade com os padrões da indústria. Além disso, ele orienta e mentoriza profissionais menos experientes, facilitando o desenvolvimento de habilidades e conhecimentos técnicos dentro da equipe. Sua liderança é fundamental para garantir a execução bem-sucedida dos projetos e para fortalecer a relação com os clientes.

Principais atribuições:

• Elaborar estimativas de custos para projetos de engenharia, considerando materiais, mão de obra, equipamentos e outros recursos necessários.

• Elaborar especificações e documentação técnica para compreender os requisitos e identificar os elementos de custo e divergências de escopo.

• Elaborar planilhas de quantidades e custos para cada fase do projeto, utilizando software especializado quando aplicável.

• Verificar e desenvolver estratégias de orçamentação que atendam às necessidades do cliente e sejam competitivas no mercado.

• Verificar e desenvolver a identificação de fatores de risco, contingências e variações de preço no orçamento, visando mitigar impactos financeiros adversos.

• Verificar cotações, realizar follow-up com fornecedores e agendar reuniões técnicas e comerciais entre clientes, tanto internos quanto externos.

• Verificar registros detalhados de todas as estimativas, incluindo suposições, fontes de dados e justificativas de custos.

• Elaborar estudos de viabilidade dos projetos, contendo fluxo de caixa e análises de sensibilidade.

• Verificar e desenvolver apresentações e relatórios técnicos, fornecendo informações claras e detalhadas sobre as estimativas de custo e as estratégias de orçamentação adotadas.

• Elaborar treinamentos relacionados ao desempenho da equipe e desenvolvimento técnico.

• Validar a lista de documentos necessárias para as atividades.

• Orientar na elaboração do cronograma do projeto.

• Liderar reuniões com clientes, garantindo a comunicação eficaz e a satisfação das partes interessadas.

• Estimar horas para engenharia, assegurando o correto dimensionamento das atividades.

• Liderar a engenharia de comissionamento e suportar as equipes conforme necessário.

• Planejar atividades relacionadas aos projetos, garantindo que os prazos e objetivos sejam cumpridos.

title: Clinical Development Leader (Medical Monitor)
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Clinical Development Leader (Medical Monitor) who wants to learn and transform his career.

Mandatory Skills :

  • MD / Physician background (non-negotiable)
  • Oncology experience
  • Clinical trial exposure (Phase 1–3)
  • Publications / research work
  • GCP / regulatory exposure
  • Licensure to practice medicine
  • English Fluent
  • 3+ years of experience in pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry or related clinical experience
  • Documented academic and/or clinical research publication history or history of medical practice in a relevant field.
  • Strong working knowledge of the clinical drug development process with experience in the conduct/participation of clinical trials (investigator initiated, company sponsored or cooperative group trials) and their subsequent publications.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements to support registration, including knowledge and adherence to GCP principles

Desired Skills:

  • The Medical Director Oncology Clinical Development will report to the Executive Medical Director, Clinical Development Lead (CDL), Oncology Clinical Development. The Medical Director will be responsible for clinical research activities pertaining to advancing the development of GSK’s clinical portfolio and will also have responsibility for engaging in medical dialogues with relevant scientific and medical leaders in order to lead clinical data generation activities. This individual will also have a leading role in managing effective relationships with Key External Experts.
  • This role requires a physician capable of developing and executing oncology clinical trials in support of the successful clinical development, regulatory filing and initial market launch of a growing portfolio of innovative and transformational Oncology agents.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with physicians, scientists, regulatory professionals, biostatisticians, regulatory, executive staff and others in a complex matrix environment to develop and execute phase 1-3 interventional clinical trials
  • Ensure high quality protocol development aligned with the Clinical Development Plan to effectively determine a medicine’s potential efficacy, safety profile, key areas of product differentiation and value to patient in the shortest possible timeframe.
  • Use medical expertise to contribute to the end to end (protocol concept to final study report) to ensure scientific integrity and timely delivery of clinical trials which ensure consistency with the clinical development strategy for regulatory approvals, reimbursable medicines, and successful lifecycle management; demonstrate ability to incorporate global considerations into decision making
  • Interpret and summarize study results consistent with objectives to define safety, efficacy, pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic, and patient reported outcomes, and applicability of data to the targeted patient population.
  • Assume medical responsibility for clinical trials with active participation in real-time medical monitoring of studies, including patient eligibility assessment, study design questions, and addressing urgent safety questions (with inclusion of Safety/ PV as relevant).
  • Assume responsibility for medical review of clinical trial data, both directly as needed and/or via oversight of delegated medical review. Oversee blinded review of data packages intended for IDMCs.
  • Review/monitor safety data in collaboration with pharmacovigilance group for active clinical studies.
  • Participate in the authoring of clinical study reports and regulatory documents and collaborate with colleagues in Regulatory Affairs, CMC, Toxicology, Research, Pharmacology to respond to health authority and ethics committee queries.
  • Collaborate with Principal Investigators in the evaluation and assessment of publications (abstracts, posters, manuscripts) associated with clinical data.
  • Network extensively to develop long-term strategic partnerships with thought leaders both internally and externally, in support of GSK’s vision.
  • Understand biological mechanisms, clinical strategy, scientific interpretation of disease and target-based literature.
  • Serve as a core member of the Clinical Matrix Team for one or more assets in development.
  • Represent Clinical Development on disease area strategy, integrated evidence and medical affairs strategy teams.
  • Participate in Oncology Clinical Development-wide initiatives and workstreams as appropriate.

Keywords:

  • phase 1-3 interventional clinical trials
  • Interpret and summarize study results consistent with objectives to define safety, efficacy,
  • Regulatory Affairs

title: Analista GIS Sênior (ArcGIS) (Presencial São Paulo/SP)
description:
Vaga de atuação presencial no Cliente, localizado em São Paulo/SP.


Descrição da vaga

O profissional deverá suportar tecnicamente a equipe técnica do cliente, executando as atividades relacionadas a configuração, manutenção e melhor uso da plataforma ArcGIS, apresentadas a seguir:


• Instalação e configuração de softwares nativos plataforma ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro e Apps);

• Atualização de versão e configuração de softwares plataforma ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro e Apps);

• Administração dos dados armazenados nos Ambientes ArcGIS Enterprise e Online;

• Demonstrações de utilização da plataforma ArcGIS Enterprise, incluindo Apps; • prontas para uso (Survey123, Dashboard, etc.);

• Mentoring e acompanhamento dos usuários da plataforma ArcGIS;

• Explicação sobre a utilização de extensões;

• Publicação e gestão dos serviços de mapas no ArcGIS Enterprise ou ArcGIS Online;

• Publicação de geoprocessing no ArcGIS Enterprise;

  • Prestar apoio no planejamento executivo dos projetos na aquisição, tratamento e gerenciamento de dados geoespaciais e alfanuméricos, realizando o levantamento de informações técnicas e analisando os insumos necessários com base em aspectos qualitativos e quantitativos;
  • Utilizar a edição de dados em geodatabase e criar modelos simples de geoprocessamento, criar, editar e explorar dados geográficos no ArcGIS Pro, criar layout simples de mapas e compartilhar mapas;
  • Utilizar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS, como ferramentas para visualizar, criar, gerenciar e analisar dados geográficos, aplicando os principais componentes e funcionalidades da Plataforma ArcGIS (Server, Mobile, Desktop, Online e extensões) e ter habilidade de identificar onde ela se aplica;
  • Utilizar ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Realizar e aplicar modelagem de um geodatabase utilizando versionamento e elementos de rede e modelos complexos de geoprocessamento;
  • Aplicar a plataforma ArcGIS para realizar análise espaciais e ser capaz de automatizar processos;
  • Criar e aplicar elementos cartográficos dinâmicos e criar layout de mapas complexos;
  • Aplicar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS e ter habilidades avançadas para aplicar as ferramentas na visualização, criação, gerenciamento e análise de dados geográficos;
  • Aplicar o uso de geotecnologia nas diversas áreas de negócios verticais de atuação da Imagem;
  • Propor a escala de trabalho adequada para a solução de diferentes problemas geográficos;
  • Resolver problemas de distorções e compreender características específicas de dados geográficos, cuja origem esteja relacionada com a fonte;
  • Ter domínio das funcionalidades do ArcGIS e propor melhorias na utilização das ferramentas para visualizar, criar, gerenciar e analisar dados geográficos e auxiliar a equipe;
  • Propor melhorias no uso das ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Domínio das principais extensões do ArcGIS e propor utilizações inovadoras na utilização das principais extensões;
  • Criar e estruturar novas metodologias de execução de serviços de geoprocessamento, estimativas e controle de qualidade conforme as características específicas a serem executadas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimentos avançados em GIS;
  • Conhecimentos das soluções e produtos ESRI (ArcGIS Pro e Apps, ArcGIS Enterprise e ArcGIS Online);
  • Compreensão referente a origem e conceitos básicos das tecnologias e metodologias para aquisição de dados geográficos;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de projeção (UTM, Lambert) e datums geográficos (WGS84, SIRGAS2000);
  • Conhecimento dos principais padrões de metadados existentes.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;

  • Inglês Avançado;

title: Inside Sales Representative (Arabic-speaking)
description:
About the Business Division:

Since our inception in 2013, Remedium have championed the recruitment of permanent healthcare professionals, supporting our clients to drive more efficient and consistent patient-led care, address future healthcare workforce staffing demands and reduce excessive agency locum spend. We are well and truly the leading provider in this sector and the innovators in the marketplace. We are the experts and are here to share our knowledge and expertise with you!

Job Description

We are seeking an Arabic-speaking Inside Sales Representative (Intern/Entry Level) to support outbound business development efforts across hospitals and healthcare systems in Arabic-speaking countries. This role focuses on prospecting and cold outreach to hospital administrators and healthcare leadership to schedule meetings for our senior sales team regarding physician recruitment services.

This position is well-suited for individuals interested in international healthcare sales, business development, or medical services partnerships . The primary objective is to generate qualified meetings with hospital decision-makers .

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct outbound calls and email outreach to hospitals and healthcare organizations in Arabic-speaking countries.
  • Identify and connect with hospital administrators and hospital decision-makers .
  • Introduce the company’s physician and clinical staffing service offerings .
  • Qualify prospects and schedule meetings for senior sales representatives.
  • Maintain accurate records of outreach activity in the CRM system .
  • Meet defined call, outreach, and meeting-setting targets .
Qualifications

Required

  • Fluent in Arabic and business-level in English (spoken and written)
  • Strong verbal communication and professional phone presence
  • Interest in sales, business development, or healthcare services
  • Ability to confidently conduct cold outreach and lead qualification
  • Organized with strong follow-up and time management skills

Preferred

  • Prior sales, telemarketing, or customer outreach experience
  • Background or coursework in business, healthcare administration, or international business
  • Familiarity with healthcare systems or hospital operations

What You’ll Gain

  • Training in sales prospecting, lead qualification, and meeting generation
  • Hands-on experience in international healthcare sales
  • Exposure to hospital operations and physician service solutions
  • Opportunity to work with a global healthcare services team
  • Potential pathway to a full-time sales or business development role

Key Metrics for Success

  • Outbound call volume
  • Qualified meetings scheduled

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Confident communicator comfortable speaking with hospital leadership
  • Interested in global healthcare markets
  • Able to work independently in a fast-paced outreach environment
Additional Information

About M3 EU:

M3 EU is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fuelled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 EU prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 EU means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 EU.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;

  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e ferramentas para sua implementação como por exemplo (JUnit e Mockito).

  • Mentalidade de qualidade: valorizamos profissionais que consideram a excelência técnica desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega, com atenção a performance, cobertura de testes e prevenção de bugs.

description:

Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.

We are looking for an Application Support Engineer to establish and drive operational support for Data Products within a complex, data-driven environment at world’s leading investment bank as our customer.

You will play a key role in incident management, system stability, and knowledge transfer, while working closely with global teams across the globe. The role combines production support, data analysis, and light development to ensure high availability and performance of critical data services.

  • Provide L2/L3 application support for Data applications

  • Support AWS-based services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda)

Additional Responsibilities

  • Support knowledge transfer activities from vendors or internal teams

Profile Requirements


Mandatory

  • 3+ years in Application Support / Production Support / Data Support roles
  • Strong SQL skills (Snowflake preferred)
  • Experience with Python or Java (scripting, automation, or support tooling)
  • Solid understanding of incident management (ITIL processes)
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Unix/Linux environments (CLI, file/process management)
  • Log analysis & troubleshooting
  • Good communication skills and fluent English


Nice to have

  • Exposure to ETL pipelines / data integration workflows
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Background in banking or financial sector or financial data / market data environments
  • Familiarity with:
  • Alloy
  • VLF-based query languages / Slang
  • Experience in high-availability environments


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Sobre a Vaga

Nós agregamos valor a commodities agrícolas desenvolvendo matérias-primas para a indústria de alimentos. AGRANA é sinônimo de produtos com excelente qualidade e ótimos serviços, bem como ideias inovadoras e expertise em desenvolvimento de produtos - que são apreciados por nossos clientes ao redor do mundo, sejam eles players globais ou regionais.

Na AGRANA Fruit nós transformamos frutas e outras matérias-primas em produtos customizados de alta qualidade para nossos clientes ao redor do mundo. Ao fazer isso, podemos oferecer uma ampla gama de soluções para diferentes segmentos de mercado, incluindo Laticínios, Sorvetes, Food Service, entre outros.

Atualmente operamos uma planta no Brasil, onde transformamos frutas Premium em preparados de altíssima qualidade. Estamos alocados em Cabreúva/SP, região bastante próxima aos principais clientes, o que viabiliza a entrega dos produtos de maneira mais fresca possível.

No momento estamos procurando um candidato dedicado e automotivado que deseja se juntar a nossa equipe como Estagiário em Melhoria Contínua.


Objetivo do Trabalho:

  • Segurança : Estar envolvido e comprometido com as questões de Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho, tendo em mente que a Segurança é o ponto inicial de cada atividade a ser desempenhada.

  • Suporte ao Gemba : Auxiliar no acompanhamento de métodos, processos e tempos em cada etapa produtiva, coletando dados para cálculos de custo e produtividade.
  • Inteligência de Dados : Apoiar na atualização de relatórios de gerenciamento e no tratamento de dados em Power BI, Excel e outras ferramentas de BI. Atualizar os relatórios de indicadores e disponibilizar nos informativos.

  • Gestão de Documentos : Apoiar o levantamento de indicadores, mapeamento de áreas e desenvolvimento de relatórios para suporte às apresentações dos gestores industriais.
  • Gestão da Rotina : Auxiliar os gestores das áreas industriais na manutenção e organização das reuniões de rotina (reuniões de resultados e masterplan);
  • Programa 5S: Realizar auditorias periódicas de 5S no Gemba, auxiliar na criação de padrões visuais e suportar as áreas na eliminação de fontes de sujeira e desvios de organização


Requisitos:

Cursando Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Alimentos ou áreas correlatas.

Sobre a ALTAVE


Proteger vidas e recursos com tecnologia, nisto consiste o propósito da ALTAVE.

Você será protagonista na evolução de sistemas críticos que sustentam as soluções ALTAVE em visão computacional, IA e gestão de alertas.

  • Melhoria Contínua: Identificar e resolver débitos técnicos, refatorar códigos legados e sugerir melhorias em processos e tecnologias.



Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Matemática ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência com +5 anos em desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de sistemas.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação (preferencialmente Python).

  • Prática em testes automatizados e TDD (Test-Driven Development).
  • Experiência em Cloud Computing (AWS e/ou GCP).
  • Inglês intermediário.


Diferenciais que valorizamos

  • Banco de dados: relacional (PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (Redis, MongoDB).
  • Mensageria com RabbitMQ.
  • Monitoramento e observabilidade (Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Sistemas operacionais Linux (Debian/Ubuntu).
  • Automação com GitHub Actions, Ansible e Terraform.
  • Orquestração com Kubernetes.


Se você é apaixonado por Arquitetura e Engenharia de Software, Cloud e DevOps e busca um ambiente desafiador e inspirador para crescer profissionalmente, venha fazer parte da ALTAVE. Aqui cada contribuição conta na proteção de vidas e recursos com tecnologia.


Na ALTAVE você encontrará:

Trabalhar na ALTAVE é incrível! Você encontrará uma estrutura que estimula autonomia com responsabilidade, aprendizado contínuo e atuação ao lado de um time altamente qualificado. Aqui você encontrará projetos desafiadores, espaço real para crescimento, participação ativa em decisões e envolvimento em iniciativas que geram impacto direto no campo e na gestão. Nosso ambiente promove colaboração, alta performance e networking com grandes players nacionais e internacionais.

Tudo isso sustentado por remuneração e benefícios competitivos e um plano de carreira estruturado para quem entrega resultado e busca evolução.


Somos Great Place To Work!

Benefícios? Muitos!

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico, TotalPass, Clude, Flash, day off no aniversário e muito mais!

title: Senior International Procurement, Transportantion and Logistics Analyst - English 90%
description:
About the job


The Senior Analyst, International Logistics, serves as a key strategic partner within the Raw Materials Procurement organization, responsible for ensuring the efficient, cost‑effective, and resilient movement of raw materials across the global supply chain. This role combines advanced data analytics with deep logistics expertise to design, optimize, and manage international transportation flows that support production, reduce total landed cost, and strengthen supplier and carrier performance. Serving as a boots‑on‑the‑ground contact, the Senior Analyst drives communication, negotiation, and alignment with both suppliers and transportation providers to ensure operational execution, strategic development and continuous improvement. The Senior Analyst maintains accurate inventory positions through accurate reporting of materials in the supply chain, identifies network inefficiencies, and develops improvement initiatives that enhance service, reduce risk, and support long‑term supply chain competitiveness. Through proactive analysis, cross‑functional collaboration, and continuous process optimization, this position ensures that the company’s global logistics operations are predictable, transparent, and aligned with broader supply chain and business


Scope. Santa Catarina Brazil


objectives


  • Support the efficient and cost‑effective movement of international raw materials by providing accurate data analysis, shipment visibility, and operational coordination.
  • Act as a connector between procurement, logistics, and supplier/carrier partners by translating operational realities and commercial priorities into clear insights and actions.
  • Identify issues and trends, and recommend opportunities for improvement across the international logistics network to strengthen service performance and reduce total landed cost.



What do you need?


To live in Santa Catarina mandatory English 90%

Educational Background: Bachelor of Science in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field, or

equivalent experience.

• Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years in transportation, international logistics, or

supply chain analytics, with a proven track record of success.

• Detailed knowledge of the North American transportation industry, including LTL, truckload, rail,

warehousing, cross-border, and airfreight

• Knowledge of standard transportation import and export procedures and USDOT requirements

• Advanced experience with transportation pricing methods and practices, customs entry

processes and brokerage/clearance requirements preferred

• Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial terms for both master transportation

agreements and ad hoc projects with carriers, brokers, customs brokers, and rail lines.

• Fundamental understanding of CHEP global operations and business segments preferred

• Thorough understanding of the CHEP network pallet flows and seasonality preferred

Skills and Knowledge • Business Acumen and Problem Solving: Apply knowledge of business rules and processes to

manage organizational tasks efficiently. Utilize strong time management and problem-solving

skills to address challenges effectively



Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with domestic and international carriers, freight forwarders, and suppliers to support reliable and cost‑effective logistics operations.
  • Recommend optimal Incoterms and transportation strategies by assessing risk, cost, and supplier capabilities.
  • Monitor international shipments to maintain accurate daily visibility, escalating delays and risks and supporting timely resolution with carriers, suppliers, and internal teams.
  • Analyze logistics and inventory flow data to identify variances, inefficiencies, and potential cost‑saving or performance‑enhancing opportunities.
  • Prepare regular reporting and dashboards covering shipment status, carrier performance, costs, and inventory impacts to support decision‑making across procurement and operations.
  • Support contract and carrier management activities by gathering performance data, documenting service issues, and contributing to review discussions.
  • Maintain routing guidelines, documentation, and SOPs, helping ensure consistency and accuracy in transportation execution and compliance.
  • Assist with root‑cause investigations into service failures or cost issues, coordinating inputs across carriers, suppliers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with planning, sourcing, operations, and transportation teams to ensure alignment on inbound flows, priorities, and risk areas.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL


BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.


Our mission is to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.


Our message to the world is simple – make everyone’s life healthier and longer with help of BGI.


Why joining us?


Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.


Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.


Why do we want you?


We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI’s values, products and services. And that’s why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.



Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:


1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.


Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:


1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.


Competences:


a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.


Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners’ physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.


Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.


· What do we offer?


1. International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team

2. work with advanced technology and products

3. comprehensive onboarding program

4. continuous knowledge and skills development

5. HQ organized training globally and in China

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

7. annual performance bonus

8. team building activities

9. salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.


Let’s move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall

title: Analista de Excelência Operacional Pleno
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.

  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação

title: Operador(a) de Área - Recuperação e Evaporação
description:
A Arauco é um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais e se compromete com a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas práticas de contratação.


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Sobre a Função


Liderar e executar atividades operacionais complexas na área de campo das unidades de Evaporação e Recuperação, garantindo o funcionamento otimizado, seguro e contínuo dos equipamentos e processos, atuando como referência técnica e mentor para a equipe operacional de campo, liderando a resposta a anomalias, participando ativamente da análise de desvios e propondo melhorias nos procedimentos e equipamentos, contribuindo para o alcance das metas de produção, segurança, eficiência energética e recuperação de químicos.


Principais Atividades:

  • Operar e monitorar equipamentos das áreas de Evaporação e Recuperação, garantindo eficiência, segurança e continuidade operacional;
  • Realizar inspeções de campo, identificando anomalias e atuando preventivamente em falhas;
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas operacionais, atuando na causa raiz e na melhoria do processo;
  • Executar ajustes operacionais visando otimização de consumo de energia, recuperação de químicos e controle ambiental;
  • Apoiar/operar sistemas automatizados (SDCD) e substituir operador de painel quando necessário;
  • Liderar e orientar operadores de campo, distribuindo atividades e garantindo cumprimento de procedimentos;
  • Preparar equipamentos para manutenção, assegurando bloqueios e condições seguras de trabalho;
  • Coletar e analisar amostras de processo, apoiando a tomada de decisão operacional;
  • Registrar dados operacionais e contribuir com análises de desempenho e melhorias;
  • Atuar em situações de emergência, seguindo planos de contingência e garantindo a segurança;
  • Garantir cumprimento das normas de segurança, qualidade, meio ambiente e compliance;
  • Participar de iniciativas de melhoria contínua e otimização dos processos;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento da equipe, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Desejável Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharias e afins;
